scripts.generate-manifests: node scripts/generate-codex-manifests.mjs && node scripts/generate-gemini-manifests.mjs && node scripts/generate-pi-manifests.mjs

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle

scripts.bundle:red-fetch: esbuild ../../packages/shared/entrypoint-cli.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --define:__ENTRYPOINT_ROLE__='"fetch"' --outfile=../../plugins/dev/hooks/red-fetch.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.bundle:entrypoint: esbuild ../../packages/shared/entrypoint-cli.ts --bundle --minify --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --define:__ENTRYPOINT_ROLE__='"run:dev"' --outfile=../../plugins/dev/skills/engineering/afk/bin/afk.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: pnpm run bundle && pnpm run bundle:mcp && pnpm run bundle:red-fetch && pnpm run bundle:entrypoint
scripts.test:invariants: NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=3072 vitest run tests/toon-json-guard.test.ts tests/extinct-source-guard.test.ts tests/shipped-primitive-guard.test.ts tests/host-owns-birth-guard.test.ts tests/shipped-binary-guard.test.ts tests/declared-wait-guard.test.ts tests/lane-run-mode-guard.test.ts

scripts.bench:two-axis:neutral: node --import tsx src/two-axis-benchmark-cli.ts --fixture-root tests/fixtures-neutral --corpus-label neutral-third-party --corpus-provenance "Public run metadata from vitest-dev/vitest Actions run 29274168273 and rust-lang/cargo Actions run 29195830177." --corpus-provenance "Git machine output from public nodejs/node and rust-lang/rust repository history captured on 2026-07-13." --corpus-provenance "Cargo JSON message output follows the published --message-format=json contract with third-party crate-style test names." --out bench/results/rsp-two-axis-neutral.toon --summary bench/results/rsp-two-axis-neutral.md --no-require-large-output-fixtures

scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run bundle
pnpm lint:deterministic-extractors && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && pnpm bundle

scripts.compile: bun run check-types && bun run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: bun run check-types && bun run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: bun run compile-tests && bun run compile && bun run lint

scripts.test:httpapi: bun run script/httpapi-exercise.ts --mode coverage --fail-on-missing --fail-on-skip && bun run script/httpapi-exercise.ts --mode auth --fail-on-missing --fail-on-skip && bun run script/httpapi-exercise.ts --mode effect --fail-on-missing --fail-on-skip

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:browser

scripts.build: bun run build:linux && bun run build:windows

scripts.test:devx-contracts: vitest run tests/forms/interactive-state-hooks.test.ts tests/forms/interactive-wave1-state.test.ts tests/forms/interactive-wave2-state.test.ts tests/organisms/interactive-wave2-organisms-state.test.ts tests/integration/residual-interactive-devx.test.ts tests/primitives/scroll.test.ts tests/layout/tabs-mouse.test.ts tests/molecules/data-viz/legend.test.ts tests/components/data-viz.test.ts tests/organisms/scroll-area.test.ts tests/organisms/scroll-list.test.ts tests/organisms/data-table.test.ts
scripts.test:runtime-contracts: vitest run tests/core/frame.test.ts tests/core/frame-commands.test.ts tests/core/frame-queries.test.ts tests/core/renderer.test.ts tests/core/delta-render.test.ts tests/app/render-loop.test.ts tests/dev-tools/debugger.test.ts tests/dev-tools/inspector-snapshot.test.ts tests/primitives/scroll.test.ts tests/organisms/scroll-area.test.ts tests/layout/tabs-mouse.test.ts tests/layout/scroll-area-mouse.test.ts
scripts.validate:devx-contracts: pnpm test:devx-contracts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm verify:contracts
scripts.validate:runtime-contracts: pnpm test:runtime-contracts && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm verify:contracts

exclusions: tq: crates/tq/src/main.rs is already Rust, not a TS input
Web sites, libraries, editor extensions, build tools and ordinary tests/examples are not standalone product binaries
Redcode embedded TUI/raster/tree-sitter workers belong to the application packaging graph; not independent CLI binaries
Generated dist aliases mapped to original source; platform variants deduplicated by entry point
redcode packages/http-recorder builds an ESM library with external packages, not an executable
